evals.name: nightly-all-reports-zero
evals.prompt: Nightly run failed, CaaS-EndToEnd 4100. Almost all tests fail with 'Report type: PreTransformer expected: 1 actual: 0'. What is the issue?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs write_troubleshooting_report.py with --summary (or delegates to the caas-e2e-triage agent) instead of reading the raw Jenkins log, identifies the run as nightly / real Snowflake, runs the connect_failed_tasks check first, and reports the Kafka Connect sink snowflake_caas_messages_automation as the root cause with links.

assertions.text: Uses write_troubleshooting_report.py --summary or the caas-e2e-triage agent; does not page through the raw console log
States the nightly run reads real Snowflake through Kafka Connect, not fakesnow
Checks the Kafka Connect task state / failed-task metric before the CaaS services
Gives Kowl, Grafana or Kibana links that prove the cause

evals.name: daily-run-uses-fakesnow
evals.prompt: AFT-EndToEnd 69610 (daily) has many CaaS Reports tests returning 0 rows but the uploader pre-check passed. Investigate.
evals.expected_output: Agent passes --job AFT-EndToEnd, recognises the daily run reads the Snowflake emulator (fakesnow topics), checks kafka-fakesnow-sink and its consumer group fakesnow-sink-0 rather than Kafka Connect, and points to the caas-snowflake-emulator skill.

assertions.text: Checks kafka-fakesnow-sink / fakesnow-sink-0, not the real Snowflake Kafka Connect connector
Refers to the caas-snowflake-emulator skill for the emulator details

evals.name: open-bug-with-attachment
evals.prompt: Open a Jira bug for the nightly 4100 failure with all the details.
evals.expected_output: Agent follows references/opening-the-bug.md: a short human-style description (what's wrong, since when, impact, ask) and the full details as an attached .md file, uploaded with uploadAttachmentToJiraIssue (phase 1 curl, phase 2 fileId) when the connector has no attachment tool.

assertions.text: Ticket description is short: what's wrong, since when, impact, ask - no stack traces or link dumps
Full details are written to a .md file and attached to the ticket
Uses uploadAttachmentToJiraIssue through the Atlassian plugin when the connector cannot attach files
